summary: Implemented the missing contract tests for the refusal-to-lesson pipeline that the parent task (task_186980f654114782af2980545228dc07) was trying to add. Three new tests added to tests/test_outcome_grounded_lessons.py: (1) test_curation_prompt_includes_finalizer_refusal_kind_in_signals verifies untracked_new_files refusal kind flows into the LLM curation prompt, (2) test_curation_prompt_finalizer_refusal_staged_new_files covers the staged_new_files variant, and (3) test_refusal_to_lesson_end_to_end exercises the full pipeline from classify_outcome to record_curated_lessons. All 12 tests in the file pass; the existing test_new_file_commit_rule_in_both_prompts_for_repo_coupled_task (in test_task_executor.py) already covered the prompt-side requirement. Contract test suite passed (5720+ passed, 21 skipped, 0 failures from code changes; one flaky k8s test is pre-existing and unrelated).
